component.name: Flow
component.summary: A modern desktop teleprompter for smooth reading and voice-controlled scripts

description.p: Flow is a teleprompter app built with web technologies and Tauri. It's designed to be simple, lightweight, and customizable.

Flow includes script editing, multiple playback modes, voice tracking, AI-assisted drafting, remote message injection, and tray controls, made for creators, educators, students, and everyone who wants to read off their screen while looking at the camera.
Native Linux build of Flow, alongside the existing Windows release.
